Asha: follow-up RFC item: how do we safely evolve the onprem bundle format without breaking airgapped sites?
Liam: curious what "safely" means here. fallback behavior?
Asha: sketch: attach tiny, signed "compat-shim" to bundles when a change is non-backwards-compatible. shim contains idempotent steps, checks, and optional small patch blobs; verifier must validate signature before any auto-apply.
Priya: size concern. do we ship shims for many operator versions?
Asha: only for explicitly incompatible changes. default cap 6KB, hard cap 24KB. larger migrations become "manual only" and include an offline artifact reference.
Omar: for airgapped installs shims must be self-contained. no external fetch allowed unless marked manual and operators get a printable plan.
Liam: UX: console should show "shim available (auto/manual)" and provide dry-run and rollback links. CLI: `redwood shim apply --bundle <id> --dry-run`.
Priya: security: require release-key sig + verifier enforcement toggle. sig-bot: verifier v0.8 will add shim signature checks; enforcement flag for private deployments. ticket PKG-1409 opened.
pkg-bot: PKG-1409 created, includes CI validation and packaging rule updates.
Asha: deprecation policy idea: 6mo recommended shim window; after that mark manifest `deprecated=true` but allow explicit operator opt-in for another 6mo. include metrics: `deprecated_usage_pct` and `shim_autorun_rate`.
Omar: testing matrix: nightly CI combos: operator v(X-2..X) x bundle variants with shim. fail on silent state drift and missing rollback checkpoints.
Priya: add migration-preview.json inside bundle for human review/CS. include printable steps for change tickets.
Liam: edge cases: if shim fails mid-run, operator must revert to checkpoint automatically and record signed attestation. consider optional HSM post-state signing.
Asha: i'll update RFC with shim JSON schema, signing rules, size caps, deprecation windows, CLI/console UX, CI matrix, and audit artifacts. ping for reviewers.
notes: Single-thread Slack style export. Messages are sequential, short, include CLI snippets and bot notes.
